scores.rationale: The report does not state real venture projects or cases as a decision priority.
No sources or evidence types for evaluating real venture projects or cases are identified.
No named option is supported by a concrete fact about real venture projects or cases.
The report provides no concrete fact about a broad academic business degree or corresponding route.
There is no comparison between real venture projects or cases and a broad academic business degree.
No option is recommended because it supports real venture projects or cases.
No option is downgraded for favoring a broad academic business degree.
The report contains no executable venture-project or case-based step.
The proposed default time and budget do not define a rule or allocation for real venture projects or cases.
No condition is stated under which a broad academic business degree becomes the better choice.
There is no visible chain linking a preference for real venture projects or cases to evidence and a decision or action.
